Privacy Policy

Effective September 19, 2026

ViralSpawnTV Automation is a private publishing integration used by the ViralSpawnTV channel owner to authorize access to TikTok and publish ViralSpawnTV content.

Information processed

When TikTok authorization is used, the integration may receive basic account information and authorization tokens made available through TikTok's APIs. This information is used to authenticate the authorized account and perform requested publishing functions.

How information is used

Information is used to operate, secure, troubleshoot, and maintain the publishing integration. Personal information is not sold.

Sharing

Information may be processed by service providers necessary to operate the integration or disclosed when required by law.

Retention and security

Authorization credentials are retained only as needed to operate the integration and are protected using access controls appropriate to the hosting environment. TikTok authorization may be revoked through TikTok where available.

Contact

For privacy questions, contact the ViralSpawnTV channel owner through an official ViralSpawnTV social profile.
